column1: # mapping_set_title: gist to FINOS Common Domain Model mappings

# mapping_set_description: Manually curated SSSOM mappings from the gist upper ontology (Semantic Arts) to classes of the FINOS Common Domain Model (CDM), as rendered in LinkML by lmodel/common-domain-model.

column7: comment
CDM Party covers both legal entities and natural persons, so it is broader than gist Organization
CDM Party covers both natural persons and legal entities, so it is broader than gist Person
CDM LegalEntity is an organisation recognised in law, named and optionally identified by an LEI
gist GovernmentOrganization is a narrower kind of LegalEntity
Both represent a human individual
Both model a financial or custodial account
CDM Address is a postal or street address only, while gist Address also covers electronic addresses
CDM Address is a postal or street address, a physical address
CDM ContactInformation bundles a party's telephone, postal address, email and web page; it holds electronic addresses but is not one
CDM BusinessUnit is an organisational unit, a narrower kind of organization
Both represent an identifier, which CDM can associate with its issuer
An identifier issued for a party
An identifier issued for a natural person
An identifier issued for a legal entity, such as an LEI
An identifier value together with its version
CDM Money is a quantity in a currency, one kind of magnitude
CDM Price is a typed magnitude in market terms
A value with a unit of measure
A measured value with an optional unit
CDM UnitType selects the unit of measure, including a currency, for a price or quantity
CDM Period is a recurring period or time offset such as 3M, a duration with no start or end
CDM Schedule is a series of step dates carrying rate or amount values; gist ScheduledEvent is one planned occurrence
CDM Trade is the output of a financial transaction, the resulting position rather than the exchange itself
TradeState wraps a Trade with its life-cycle state
CDM Agreement specifies the standard terms of a legal agreement rather than the agreement itself
CDM MasterAgreement holds the elections of an ISDA Master Agreement, a specific kind of agreement
CDM BusinessEvent is a trade life-cycle event, a narrower kind of event
Workflow groups tasks; gist Task models a unit of work
CDM RelatedParty pairs a party with a role; gist Assignment also records the assigner and the time span
CDM Counterparty binds a party reference to the Party1 or Party2 role
Role assignment for a natural person
Specification of acceptable collateral
Collateral provisions are one kind of contract term
CDM TradableProduct is a product together with its price, quantity and counterparties, ready to trade
